input_ancestry: The locked coin, capture, opening and rail phases supply the material. Apparatus choices include the uniform age table, the two ordinary feed profiles, the bin for early first writes, the private optical cursor, the local rail analyzers and the number of simulated trials. No measured particle or laboratory constants enter the design.
appointments: Two 3 by 3 by 3 public carriers, private periods 2 and 4. A trial is enrolled by any first write before the eighth local neutral return. On refusal retain that original launch. Only the binary enrollment and the terminal counts enter the comparison. Per-birth times and sites are hidden from the receiver. A lab reads an equipped independent free cursor, with no interaction between the optical copy and the material other than the named pointer trigger. Optical returns [80,81,101,239,683,1095,1915,2997,4043] are unblinded only after the elapsed decoder runs. The two-service cursor includes its preparation and its own 8192-state reversible counter. It resolves private parity without a which-position mark.
measurements: Full native eight-slot evolution generates phase probabilities independently of the elapsed decoder. Each fixture has four fixed local receivers. At each appointment and menu 2^36 independent original launches are drawn as one multinomial sufficient statistic. The seven outcomes are +X,+Y,-X,-Y,enrolled elsewhere,early enrollment refusal,unavailable reference. The displaced cursor has no appointments and is kept separately. The local detectors do not read the material age. A non-enrolled arrival cannot enter the hand.
gates: For each of eight later appointments, the two material count words pooled across booked stations and fixtures must give exactly one candidate even elapsed interval in [0,8191], containing the independent optical return difference in native-service units. The decoder receives neither the time labels nor the optical counts. Calibrated delta uses the source phases. With a rate inferred from optical intervals instead, retain every possible alias and require coverage of both the source rate and its pi alias. Use simultaneous conditional two-sided binomial intervals across all 216 booked words at family error 1e-6 and original-cell error 2e-11. The native two-step quadrature identity must hold within 2e-11. Untouched passive births must fail at least one of the eight exact elapsed decodes. Removing rail coherence must leave all 4096 even delays admissible. A misplaced optical cursor must fail to trigger.
domains: The cadence proof and inferred interval use matched parity and a pre-wrap enrollment. An exact frequency or a known maximum number of services are source information, not extra measurements. The count reader reports the even comparison ambiguity. A material-only record does not give a laboratory time unit. Keep all failures and nulls.
